purpose: Determine whether rollout and actor-recomputed Pi0.5 action log probabilities already disagree before any optimizer step, after the V15.7 one-update checkpoint produced zero paired real-RoboTwin success gain and showed high aggregate KL/clipping.
instrumentation_scope: In the actual EmbodiedFSDPActor used by Pi0.5, compare full train mode, train mode with the officially frozen VLM restored to eval, and full eval mode against rollout behavior probabilities; restore mode and abort before policy loss, backward, or optimizer step.
metrics: delta mean, absolute mean and maximum
importance ratio mean and absolute error from one
element count and exact equality fraction
eval-versus-rollout and train-versus-eval absolute log-ratio means
frozen-VLM-restored versus rollout absolute log-ratio mean and equality fraction

decision.consistent: If the first train-mode forward ratio is approximately one and clipping approximately zero, attribute one-update KL primarily to optimizer movement and diagnose update magnitude versus reward signal next.
decision.inconsistent: If the first train-mode forward ratio materially differs from one, diagnose rollout-versus-training probability compatibility before any formal 1000-step run.
